issue.title: CJP & the Education Minister's resignation
issue.summary: How a satirical youth party born from a Chief Justice's 'cockroaches' remark (15-16 May 2026) turned the NEET-UG 2026 paper-leak anger into a Jantar Mantar movement that ended with Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation on 25 July 2026, and where it went next (CJP-D split, Election Commission ultimatum).

also_issues.title: NEET-UG 2026 paper leak & exam reform (candidate issue)

issue.edition: public: confirmed, reported and disputed facts plus attributed claims. Inferred events, inferred links and hypotheses are kept in the local research edition only.
